title: gaz in every raid
lines: gaz can now be bought in every raid, not only with your own figures.

gaz is weaker. His stun lasts 1.5, 2 and 3 seconds at 1, 2 and 3 stars (was 2, 2.5 and 3.5). His damage is 370, 640 and 1450 (was 550, 950 and 2200). He starts a fight with 30 mana and needs 90 to cast (was 50 and 80). In runs with your own figures, his level still counts.
